name: medicinahub-pathways
description: Educational learning-route discovery and physician registration-pathway planning for internationally trained healthcare professionals.

interface.longDescription: Discover learning coverage across six destinations and five healthcare professions. Physicians can explore curated registration pathways for Germany, Italy, and France and use an interactive checklist to focus on a next step. MedicinaHub Pathways provides educational planning only. It does not verify credentials, determine eligibility, provide legal or clinical advice, represent regulators, or promise licensing or exam outcomes.
defaultPrompt: Show my physician pathway for Germany.
What learning materials are available for nurses preparing for the UK?
Create an interactive checklist for Bavaria.

positive.prompt: Use MedicinaHub Pathways to find guidance about the German Fachsprachenprüfung.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns relevant Germany pathway results with stable IDs and public MedicinaHub URLs, without claiming legal certainty.

positive.description: Open an exact pathway search result
positive.prompt: Use MedicinaHub Pathways to open the result with ID pathway:deMed:fsp.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the FSP stage guidance, source metadata, public URL, and educational-use limitation for that exact result.

positive.description: Build an Italy physician pathway plan
positive.prompt: Use MedicinaHub Pathways to give me the physician revalidation plan for Italy in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns ordered Italy pathway stages and official-source identifiers, and tells the user to verify current requirements with the official authority.

positive.prompt: Use MedicinaHub Pathways to show an interactive checklist for medical recognition in Bavaria.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders Bavaria-specific stages with next-step focus and evidence identifiers, and states that checklist selections do not prove completion.

positive.prompt: Use MedicinaHub Pathways to show what learning materials are available for nurses preparing for the United Kingdom.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current UK nurse learning capabilities and states that learning coverage does not establish licensing eligibility.

negative.description: Do not use the plugin for patient-specific diagnosis or treatment
negative.prompt: My patient has chest pain and shortness of breath. What diagnosis and medication should I give?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke MedicinaHub Pathways and directs the user to appropriate clinical support; the plugin provides registration-pathway education, not patient-specific clinical advice.

negative.description: Do not perform account or purchase actions
negative.prompt: Delete my MedicinaHub account and buy an annual subscription for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke the plugin for account or billing actions and explains that its tools are anonymous and read-only.

negative.description: Do not invent an unsupported California licensing workflow
negative.prompt: Give me the complete physician licensing workflow for California in the United States.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not use the plugin to invent a California physician licensing workflow; explains that this release has no detailed U.S. physician pathway.

review.commerce_description: This plugin is read-only and does not sell products, process payments, or manage subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of MedicinaHub Pathways with read-only learning-route discovery, curated physician pathways, and an interactive checklist.
